baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated prevention clause, guidance already having come, and the two later arrivals in the exception.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse denies an effective external barrier once gentle direction has arrived, then exposes a self-imposed threshold: assent is deferred until an inherited course or punishment becomes a direct encounter.

activation_trace.role: A barrier between a person and a desired act supplies the obstruction that the negation asks the reader to relocate.
Gentle direction toward road and truth marks guidance as already sufficient for orientation.
Heart-settling assent names the response withheld despite that orientation.
Arrival and occurrence establish that guidance has already crossed into the people's situation.
The repeated image of coming transfers the demanded proof from arrived guidance to arriving precedent or punishment.
A running path and followed practice makes the predecessors' sunna a repeatable course rather than inert information.
Face-to-face confrontation gives the awaited punishment the directness people demand before responding.

changed_reading.before: People fail to believe because guidance has not persuaded them.
changed_reading.after: Guidance has already arrived; the exceptional obstruction is their demand that inherited consequence or punishment become the next face-to-face arrival before they assent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired responses `yu'minu` and `yastaghfiru rabbahum` before `al-'adhab`.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief and seeking forgiveness form two linked shelters: trusted inward security and protection from the aftereffect of fault through the Lord's repair. Refusing both leaves the people exposed to what they insist on meeting.

activation_trace.role: Security and settled trust make belief an entered state of safety, not bare proposition-acceptance.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer from its effect makes seeking forgiveness a second protective move.
Repair, nurture, and completion identify the Lord as the agent to whom damaged relation can be brought for repair.
Painful penalty is the exposure opposed to the two offered protections.

changed_reading.before: Belief and seeking forgiveness are two devotional duties listed before punishment.
changed_reading.after: They are paired protective responses available before encounter: settle into trusted safety and seek shielding from fault's effect through the Lord's repair; waiting turns avoidable exposure into punishment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The predecessors' sunna is personified as something that comes: a followed current beginning with earlier people and carrying its own outcome toward the present audience.

activation_trace.role: A running, followed course supplies continuity from predecessors to the present.
Beginning and precedence locate the first carriers of the course.
Return to an outcome lets their priority carry a consequential endpoint, not chronology alone.
Coming turns precedent from remembered report into an approaching process.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks people to remember what happened to earlier peoples.
changed_reading.after: The earlier peoples' followed course, including the outcome to which it returned, is portrayed as an approaching process that can reach the present people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plant sequence gives the arriving sunna a visible process-form: enlivening growth passes into brittle breakage and then dispersal. Precedent can therefore be read as recurrence already legible in ordinary material change.

activation_trace.role: Earth enlivened by rain and vegetation supplies the cycle's generative phase.
Dry, broken vegetation supplies the internal collapse of what had flourished.
Wind-winnowing and flight carry the collapsed material into final dispersal.

structural_cues: 18:45 orders watered life, dry breakage, and wind-scattering as one transformation rather than a loose set of images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered material cycle; I infer that it analogizes the focus's approaching sunna, while the live alternative is that it only illustrates worldly transience.

changed_reading.before: The predecessors' sunna is chiefly a reported historical precedent.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a recurrent process whose outcome is already visible in how flourishing matter ripens into breakage and dispersal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context reverses a one-way picture in which punishment merely comes to people. Ground is uncovered, people are displayed and made to come as at first creation, and their deeds become present; the face-to-face event is reciprocal disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and uncovering strip the ground of concealment and open the disclosure sequence.
Bringing something out for inspection makes the people themselves the displayed material.
Coming now belongs to the people, reversing the focus's motion of consequences coming to them.
Beginning and precedence make first creation the measure of their return.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness bring deeds into the same exposed encounter.

structural_cues: 18:47-49 moves from exposed earth, to arrayed people and first creation, to an exhaustive record and deeds found present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal coming and a staged removal of concealment; I infer that this specifies `qubulan` as total exposure, while the alternative is that these are adjacent judgment scenes without a single spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Punishment advances toward stationary recipients and confronts them.
changed_reading.after: The confrontation also brings them forward: world, persons, record, and deeds are mutually exposed, so `qubulan` is unavoidable disclosure rather than proximity alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The obstruction acquires a social mechanism: people adopt an enemy line as intimate support; when that network is called, it cannot answer and the supposed bond becomes the barrier between its parties.

activation_trace.role: Taking as acquisition or adoption makes the rival relation an active choice.
Love, aid, and alliance specify the falsely protective social bond adopted in place of the Lord.
Enemy and enmity disclose that the adopted protection is structurally hostile.
Verbal response and answer, explicitly absent, expose the alliance's failure under summons.
A barrier between two parties converts failed closeness into separation and echoes the focus's prevention.

structural_cues: 18:50 names the chosen allies as enemies; 18:52 has those partners called, unresponsive, and separated by a mawbiq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen enemy-alliance, failed answer, and intervening barrier; I infer that such allegiance helps produce the focus's withheld trust, while the alternative is that it is one refusal-example rather than the general mechanism.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified obstacle keeps individuals from belief.
changed_reading.after: One obstacle can be adopted allegiance: a hostile relation is treated as protection until judgment reveals its silence and turns the bond itself into a barrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The barrier is an active rhetorical procedure. Varied examples are repeatedly turned into twisted dispute; falsehood is used to make truth lose its footing, and warning is converted into mockery.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing through differing states supplies the Qur'an's varied presentation and the material repeatedly redirected by disputants.
Twisted contention identifies the dominant human response to the many examples.
The repeated twisted dispute shows the response becoming an intentional counter-action after warning.
A slipping foot gives the adversarial aim a physical mechanism: make truth lose purchase.
Mockery converts signs and warnings from claims demanding response into objects denied seriousness.

structural_cues: 18:54 places abundant, diversified examples immediately before the focus; 18:56 expands disputation into using falsehood against truth and treating warnings as mockery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variation, dispute, attempted slippage, and mockery; I infer a causal counter-procedure that neutralizes arrived guidance, while the alternative is a list of correlated refusal behaviors without one process.

changed_reading.before: Prevention sounds like a static barrier or simple lack of persuasion.
changed_reading.after: Prevention is performed: examples are twisted into dispute, truth is pushed toward slippage, and warning is recoded as mockery, so informational abundance can intensify resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah sequences active turning and abandonment before coverings over hearts and weight in ears. The obstruction thus reads as a response that sedimented into impaired reception, not an original shortage of evidence.

activation_trace.role: Turning one's side away supplies the initial active refusal after reminder.
Leaving and neglecting what the hands advanced extends refusal into abandonment of one's own record.
A preserving cover becomes occlusive over the heart, hardening earlier avoidance into blocked understanding.
Weight in the ear gives blocked reception a sensory load rather than a missing message.
Gentle direction remains the destination of the call even when the formed barriers prevent uptake.

structural_cues: 18:57 orders reminder, turning away, forgetting prior action, imposed heart-coverings and ear-weight, then a call to guidance that no longer yields guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered refusal and reception barriers; I infer hardening from the order, while the materially live alternative is coexistence rather than a causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus's obstacle is static and unexplained at the moment guidance comes.
changed_reading.after: The obstacle is acquired and hardened: active turning and neglect precede occluded understanding and weighted hearing, so later inability does not imply initial evidential lack.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explains non-arrival as mercy rather than absence. Forgiveness and tenderness suspend immediate taking despite earnings, but a fixed appointment remains with no refuge; destroyed towns show the timed course after wrongful withholding. Waiting for punishment therefore wastes the interval designed for the focus's two protective responses.

activation_trace.role: Covering fault and protecting its bearer from effect repeats the focus's offered avenue as an active divine quality.
Tender mercy supplies the reason immediate consequence is withheld.
Hastening and advancing, negated in the conditional, identify delay as deliberate non-acceleration.
Painful penalty names what could have been advanced but is deferred.
An appointment fixed by time or place converts reprieve into a bounded interval.
Refuge and escape, explicitly unavailable at the appointment, close the later exit that forgiveness presently opens.
Falling into destruction supplies an instantiated endpoint for earlier communities.
Withholding and confining the right supplies the moral obstruction tied to that endpoint and echoes the focus's prevention.

structural_cues: 18:58 contrasts possible immediate taking with forgiveness, mercy, delay, appointment, and no refuge; 18:59 joins prior towns' wrongdoing, destruction, and an appointed time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies merciful non-hastening, a fixed appointment, no later refuge, and prior timed destruction; I infer that the delay functions as opportunity for belief and forgiveness, while the alternative is delay as decree without an opportunity-purpose.

changed_reading.before: Punishment has not come, so people treat its absence as permission to postpone response.
changed_reading.after: Its non-arrival is a bounded mercy-window: the Lord could hasten consequence but leaves time for trust and forgiveness; insisting on encounter mistakes reprieve for exemption until refuge closes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because `huda` is plainly guidance while the packet also maps its QAC root to a non-dominant h-d-d warning branch. It remains anchored at focus index 8 and fits the later warning-to-punishment motion, but downstream prose must present it only as a split-root echo, never as a replacement lexical meaning for `huda`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `al-huda` at index 8, between guidance's arrival and the awaited arrivals of precedent or punishment.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction to road and truth preserves the focus word's primary semantic anchor.
The split-root image of warning and threat adds an exploratory shadow in which arrived guidance already bears warning pressure.
The coming of calamity or destruction lets the warning-shadow become event in the later arrival.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and punishment are cleanly separate: one instructs and the other later penalizes.
changed_reading.after: Guidance remains gentle direction, but its split-root shadow already sounds a warning; waiting for punishment means refusing the warning until its content arrives as event.

strongest_changes: 18:47-49 changes one-way punishment into reciprocal exposure: people, world, record, and deeds are all brought into presence.
18:54-57 identifies a process from twisted dispute and mockery through active turning to hardened reception barriers.
18:58-59 makes delay a bounded mercy-window whose available refuge closes at the appointed recurrence.
summary.what_was_special: The decisive activation was the choreography of coming and exposure combined with paired protection vocabulary: context turned an abstract blocker into a chosen rhetorical and social process that can harden while mercy delays its consequence.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether `sunnatu al-awwalin` foregrounds historical precedent, a visible recurrent process, or the outcome carried by that process.
Whether 18:57's ordering licenses a causal hardening account or only co-describes refusal and incapacity.
The h-d-d warning resonance is a packet-supported split-root outlier, not a lexical reading of `huda`.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Arrival is perversely deferred until consequence.** `ء ت ي` B001 (“coming and arriving”) repeats: guidance has already arrived, yet people behave as though only inherited destruction or face-to-face punishment can count as arrival. The cave sign was disclosed so observers could know the promise (18:21), and the barrier’s end arrives by promise (18:98). I infer that refusal raises the evidentiary threshold until learning and punishment coincide. The blockage is demand for coercive visibility.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:98 demonstrated the eventual arrival of a promise that successful engineering cannot postpone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Prior precedent demanded as present confrontation.** `ق ب ل/B002` supplies priorness, while `ق ب ل/B001` supplies facing and visible confrontation. The `سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ` gives the prior pattern and `قُبُلًا` turns consequence into something faced; messengers in 18:56 already bring warning, but their hearers use dispute to dislodge truth. I infer that the people accept no mediated guidance, demanding that precedent become immediate encounter. The closing alternatives read as a self-imposed evidentiary threshold that makes belief arrive too late.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:56–57 showed warning already present but converted into dispute and perceptual cover, explaining why only direct confrontation remains acceptable.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir kişiyle istediği nesne veya eylem arasına girerek onu durdurmayı ve bırakmaya yöneltmeyi açıkça belirtir. Dalın kimliği, vermeme anlamından ve erişilmezlik sağlayan koruyucu güçten bağımsız bir amaç engelleme ilişkisine dayanır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أن يحول المانع بين الإنسان والشيء أو الفعل الذي يريده، وأن يصده ويحمله على تركه، ومنه منعته الشيء أو منعته عن الشيء فامتنع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: منعته أمنعه منعا فامتنع أي حلت بينه وبين إرادته (ayn)؛ منعت الرجل عن الشئ فامتنع منه (sihah)؛ المنع أن تحول بين الرجل وبين الشيء الذي يريده (tahdhib)؛ ما الذي صدك وحملك على ترك ذلك (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المكان والحصن والرجل ذو المنعة، والعز الذي معه من يحمي ويمنع، ومنع الله أهل دينه بمعنى حاطهم ونصرهم.
يدخل فيه وصف المرأة بمنيعة أو منعة أو العفيفة التي تتمنع ولا تؤاتى على فاحشة.
يدخل فيه مناع إذا أريد بها صيغة أمر بمعنى امنع، على مثال نزال بمعنى انزل.
يدخل فيه مانعته الشيء ممانعة، أي وقع بينهما دفع وممانعة متبادلة في الشيء.
يدخل فيه المتمنعتان: البكرة والعناق، لأنهما تمتنعان على السنة بفتائهما وتشبعان قبل الجلة، كأنهما تقاتلان الزمان عن أنفسهما.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإنس والبشر والناس والأناسي والإنسان من حيث الجماعة أو الواحد، وما بالدار أنيس بمعنى أحد.

branches.branch_image_ar: إيناس الشيء برؤية أو إحساس أو سماع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

branches.branch_image_ar: إنسان العين وصورة الإنسان في السواد
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
يدخل فيه كيف ابن إنسك للسؤال عن النفس، وفلان ابن أنس فلان لصفيه وخاصته، وما قاربه من الخدن والأنيس والخلص والجليس.
يدخل فيه تفسير حتى تستأنسوا بالاستئذان أو السلام وطلب الدخول، أو بإيجاد إيناس قبل الدخول.

root_profile.summary: Kök, insan türünü adlandırma, duyularla fark etme ve yabancılığın kalkıp yakınlık oluşması çevresinde birkaç bağlı anlam geliştirir. Ayrıca insana dönük yan, gözde görülen küçük görüntü, kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını ve eve girişten önce kabul arama gibi belirgin biçimde ayrılmış kullanımları vardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمن ضد الخوف، والأمان وإعطاء الأمنة، والأمانة ضد الخيانة وما اؤتمن عليه، والآمن والمأمن والاستئمان، والأمين والمأمون وما يوثق به، ومنه وثاقة الناقة الأمون.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu dali korkutma, gozdagi verme ve uzaktan savrulan kotu soz alaninda kurar. Bu dal ses, yikim veya ovgu degildir; alicida korku dogurmayi hedefleyen sozlu tutum cekirdektir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tur bare; tanim genel korkutma ve gozdagi cekirdegini verir, belirli kaliba baglamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, birine zarar veya kotuluk gelecegini sezdirerek korkutma ve gozdagi verme anlamindadir. Uzaktan veya dolayli savrulan korkutucu sozler de bu alana baglanir.

facets.statement: Birini korkutmak icin zarar veya kotuluk ihtimali bildirme.

Uzaktan veya dolayli bicimde savrulan korkutucu soz de bu alandadir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali korkutma ve gozdagi verme alaninda birlestirir. Bir kayit, uzaktan veya dolayli bicimde savrulan korkutucu sozu de ayni alana baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Zarar ihtimali bildirip baskasinda korku uyandirma cekirdegini acik bicimde karsilar.

error_profile.preserves: Korkutma, gozdagi ve zarar ihtimali bildirme korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zarar tehdidi ayrintisi baglamdan anlasiliyorsa en sade akici karsiliktir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dolayli veya uzak mesafeden gelen korkutucu soz baglaminda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaktan gelen korkutucu soz ve gozdagi korunur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal baskasinda cekinme veya dikkat dogurabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal gozdagi vererek korkutur; komsu dalda amac her zaman gozdagi degil, tehlikeden sakindirma veya uyarmadir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de korku alaninda bulusur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal korku uyandiran eyleme aittir; komsu dal korkunun kendisi ve korkuyla olusan durumlara daha genistir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir suçu bağışlama ile kişiyi cezanın dokunuşundan koruma sonuçlarını açıkça bir araya getirir; ayrıca bağışlanma istemeyi ve çok bağışlayan niteliğini aynı anlam ailesinde gösterir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu katmanları doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bağışlama çekirdeği ile bağışlanma isteme, çok bağışlayan niteliği ve belirli cümle kalıpları ayrıştırılır; kalıba bağlı anlamlar çekirdeği genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir suçu bağışlayarak kişiyi o suçun cezasından korumaktır. İlgili türevler bağışlanma istemeyi ve çok bağışlayan olma niteliğini de belirtir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, işlenmiş bir suçu bağışlamaktır.

Aynı anlam ailesi bağışlanma istemeyi ve çok bağışlayan olma niteliğini de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suçu bağışlamayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve bu işlemin kişiyi cezadan koruyan sonucunu belirtir; isteme biçimleri ile çok bağışlayan niteliği bu çekirdeğin türevleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه زئبر الثوب إذا ثار، والشعر أو الزغب على الساق أو الجبهة، والغفير الشعر السائل في القفا.
يدخل فيه رجوع المرض أو الجرح إلى حال أسوأ بعد تحسن، بصيغ غفر الجرح أو غفر المريض.
يدخل فيه الغفر ولد الأروية، والمغفر أو المغفرة أم ذلك الولد بحسب عبارات المصادر.
يدخل فيه الغفر بوصفه ثلاثة أنجم صغار من منازل القمر ومن الميزان.
يدخل فيه المغفور أو المغافير الخارجة من العرفط أو الرمث أو غيرهما، وما يشبه الصمغ أو يجتنى من الشجر.
يدخل فيه التعبير جماء الغفير أو جم الغفير عند مجيء القوم بجماعتهم وكثرتهم، الشريف والوضيع، بلا تخلف.

يدخل فيه الإيالة والسياسة، وآل الأمير رعيته إذا ساسها، وآل ماله إذا أصلحه، والائتيال والإصلاح وجمع الأمر أو رد الضالة في الدعاء.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından başka bir şeyden önce bulunmasıdır. Yaklaşan yıl ya da gece ile bir yaşam evresinin başlangıcı, bu öncelik çizgisinin ileriye dönük özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey, zaman, yer, sıra veya düzey bakımından sonrakinin önünde bulunur.
Henüz gelmemiş yıl veya gece, yaklaşan ve sırada olan dönem diye belirtilir.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, yaşlılık belirtisi henüz görünmeden önceki başlangıç dönemi olarak anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar önce ile sonra arasındaki karşıtlığı temel alır ve bu ilişkiyi yaklaşan dönemlere, gelecekteki zamana ve gençliğin ilk evresine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Öncelik ile gelecek dönemin yaklaşmasını tek bir sıra ilişkisi içinde anlatır.

يدخل فيه القبيل الكفيل والقبالة والكفالة وتقبل فلان بغيره والعهد المكتوب
يدخل فيه القبيل والقبيلة وقبائل العرب وسائر الناس والجماعات والأصناف والعريف الذي يقبل على القوم وكرم الطرفين من النسب
يدخل فيه قبائل الرأس وشعبه وقبال النعل واللجام وسيوره وقبيل الغزل ودبيره والرقاع والأحناء وما ضم بعضه إلى بعض
